author: Xufen Tu
title: 善意一旦开始组织，就开始产生责任
observation: When personal goodwill becomes organized social action, expectations, interpretations, and responsibility boundaries emerge among participants.
current_judgment: Goodwill should remain voluntary and bounded; organizing care for others requires clear expectations so responsibility does not silently shift onto one person.
boundary: An organizer can offer space, care, and opportunity, but should not absorb responsibility for each participant's choices, responses, or participation.
